tours.name: Credit Sales Order
tours.description: Step-by-step guide to selling to a credit customer on 14 Days payment terms: create the quotation, set the payment type to Credit and the payment terms to 14 Days, confirm it, deliver the goods, invoice the customer and record the payment. Before you start: you need access to the Sales app and an existing credit customer who has no overdue invoices (this guide uses DIDULA MOTORES). In every screenshot the red box shows exactly what to click or fill in.

description_i18n.en_US: Step-by-step guide to selling to a credit customer on 14 Days payment terms: create the quotation, set the payment type to Credit and the payment terms to 14 Days, confirm it, deliver the goods, invoice the customer and record the payment. Before you start: you need access to the Sales app and an existing credit customer who has no overdue invoices (this guide uses DIDULA MOTORES). In every screenshot the red box shows exactly what to click or fill in.
